files.game/data/voice/voice_profiles.json: Authoring voice directions and selected reference metadata consumed by tools/voice/intake.py for recording sheets and Omni Studio requests. The game plays authored audio and mouth cues; it does not load a speech model or these casting instructions.
files.game/data/voice/guest_turns.json: Offline voice performance attribution consumed by tools/voice/catalog.py and validated by tools/tests/test_voice_guest_turns.py: exact source bindings, guest span offsets and editorial separator provenance. Runtime receives rendered audio and mouth cues, not this authoring map.
files.game/data/voice/speech_spans.json: Offline source-preserving speech projection consumed by tools/voice/catalog.py and validated by tools/tests/test_voice_speech_spans.py. Character spans distinguish spoken words from authored acting directions; provenance and gaps remain authoring metadata, not runtime dialogue writers.

fields.game/data/audio_cues.json:door_knock: Cue id presented dynamically: AudioPolicy looks every cue up by the id its caller passes (cues[cue_id]), and DoorProp presents interaction.door_knock from a const. Same read shape as every other cue id, which predate the baseline.
